Description:
Opens a file of this File Storage for reading with a user provided buffer.
If not otherwise specified by the provided mode, the file is opened with the seek position set to
the beginning (corresponding to kAtTheBeginning).
The provided buffer will be used by the ReadAccessor to implement block-wise reading to
speed up multiple small accesses to the file.
The file will be closed when the returned UniqueHandle goes out of scope.
